stemMd: A component 4 mm long is drawn at scale 5:1. How long is it on the drawing?
explanationMd: A 5:1 scale means five drawing units for one actual unit. Multiply the actual 4 mm by 5 to get 20 mm on paper.

distractorRationale.c: This confuses the scale factor with the drawn length.
distractorRationale.b: This treats an enlargement as a reduction.
